messages:
pagerbot: ALERT: High GPU queue growth detected for service=inference-stream region=us-west-2. queue_len=12,300 (>10k threshold). autoscaler attempted scale but hit replica_limit. Pager triggered. :rotating_light:

alex.m: seeing this in metrics too, spike started ~5m ago. Latency SLOs spiking on p50/p95. Paging oncall.

maria.r: @alex.m taking this. quick check: autoscaler logs show failed scale attempts with error 'quota exceeded' and 'max replicas reached'.

cheng.l: attaching recent batcher logs, looks like continuous batch window shrank unexpectedly and prefetch miss-rate jumped. Could be config drift from last rollout.

samir.k: fyi customer call (acme-inc) just reported degraded responses (~timeouts). marking customer-impact=partial.

alex.m: live mitigation plan: 1) open handoff to infra 2) if autoscaler stuck, manually scale pool 3) revert recent batching config push 4) throttle non-critical routes. Anyone object?

maria.r: +1 on manual scale and revert. Which pool?

cheng.l: pool name inference-gpu-pool-2. The recent config changed these params in the batch controller:

```
batch_idle_window_ms: 8
batch_merge_threshold: 0.3
kv_prefetch_factor: 0.6   # used to be 1.0
prefetch_ttl_ms: 12000
```

We pushed a tweak to kv_prefetch_factor to reduce memory, that probably caused more misses. Miss rate up 42% since push.

alex.m: ok, executing manual scale now to buy time. running: `rictl scale --pool inference-gpu-pool-2 --replicas 48`

deploy-bot: @alex.m scale job accepted: job_id=scale-341210-a, previous=32, target=48. Will report status in ~90s.

samir.k: starting customer notification draft for support-bridge: "We are seeing degraded performance due to GPU capacity limits and batching cache misses; team is scaling and reverting config. Expect improvement within ~3-10 minutes."

support-bridge: copying that to ACME support channel now.

pagerbot: Scale job finished: job_id=scale-341210-a status=success new_replicas=48.

alex.m: good. but queue still high, throughput not improving as expected. looks like batcher still dropping tokens because of heavy prefetch miss churn. Need to revert kv_prefetch_factor and batch_idle_window to previous values.

cheng.l: I can rollback batch controller config. Reverting to: kv_prefetch_factor=1.0, batch_idle_window_ms=20, batch_merge_threshold=0.6, prefetch_ttl_ms=30000

alex.m: do a canary rollback first to one lane, then global if healthy. Use the canary label `canary=batch-revert-341210`.

cheng.l: executing rollback: `confctl apply --env prod --selector lane=us-west-2 --file revert-batch-341210.yaml --label canary=batch-revert-341210`

deploy-bot: config rollout started: rollout_id=roll-341210-b. Monitoring health for 2 minutes.

maria.r: also throttling some low-priority jobs: route /batch-analytics -> throttled to 1r/s to free capacity. `rictl route update --name batch-analytics --rate 1r/s`

alex.m: noting all mitigations so we can reconstruct timeline for postmortem. Customer impact still partial; ticket updated.

pagerbot: Rollout completed: rollout_id=roll-341210-b status=healthy.

cheng.l: after rollback, kv-prefetch miss-rate dropped from 42% -> 4% in 45s. Throughput jumped ~28%. queue_len falling now: 12,300 -> 3,400.

samir.k: confirmed with support: ACME saw improvement within ~6 minutes of mitigation. Updated customer note.

alex.m: great. next steps: 1) temporary increase replica_limit to avoid blocker while we audit deployment gating 2) add automated preflight check for kv_prefetch_factor changes (must run a throughput regression check) 3) postmortem to root cause config drift in canary path.

maria.r: open a P0 ticket for postmortem and action items. assigning to eng-runtime and eng-infra.

cheng.l: log snippet for timeline (from batcher):

```
[3412100001] Batcher: prefetch miss_rate=0.42 throughput=5800 tok/s
[3412100100] Autoscaler: scale_attempt -> error quota_exceeded max_replicas=32
[3412100300] Deploy: batch-controller apply change kv_prefetch_factor=0.6
[3412100600] Batcher: prefetch miss_rate=0.60 throughput=4200 tok/s
[3412100900] Scale manual triggered -> target 48
[3412101200] Batcher: post-rollback miss_rate=0.04 throughput=7400 tok/s
```

alex.m: tagging infra and runtime leads for follow-up: @cheng.l @maria.r please coordinate the postmortem. I'll collect timeline and customer comms.

support-bridge: ACME acknowledged the update and requested a runbook entry for future throttle events.

samir.k: copying incident summary to #incidents-summary and scheduling 30m postmortem sync.

pagerbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: queue growth mitigated, throughput restored, autoscaler unblocked. Root cause suspected: risky reduction of kv_prefetch_factor in production without regression gates; follow-ups required. :white_check_mark:

alex.m: closing thread for live mitigation. Leave the ticket open for postmortem actions. Thanks everyone. :tada:
